prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 64x64 pixel-art inventory icon for a dark-fantasy game.
Subject: Bogwatch Gauntlets. Short iron gauntlets have broad rounded knuckle shells and overlapping finger plates. Green water stains collect at the hinges above torn brown leather cuffs with large square buckles.
Style: Crisp pixel art for a weathered dark-fantasy inventory. Muted earth colors, distinct weighted silhouettes, selective bright metal edges, restrained magical accents, and readable large pixel clusters.
Composition: One complete isolated item, centered with a clear four-pixel margin, no hands or wearer, no scenery, no labels or UI frame. Weapons lean from lower left to upper right; armor and jewelry use a slight three-quarter view. A pair of gloves counts as one item.
Render one icon only, not a sheet. Square canvas, true transparent alpha background. The object occupies about 80% of the frame. Use chunky pixel clusters at a logical 64x64 scale, a dark one-pixel silhouette outline, and simple three-tone shading. No floor, cast shadow, backdrop, lettering, watermark, glow cloud or surrounding border.
